title: Clash Arena: team play, card identity and individual avatar mastery
scope: Starting lessons for a learned command controller. Strategic advice can be revised by experience; mechanical rules remain enforced.
mechanics: Destroy the opposing outer turret, inner turret and Nexus turret in that order. Deeper structures are protected until their preceding turrets are destroyed.
After the Nexus turret falls, destroy all three barracks: melee, ranged and catapult. The Nexus remains protected until all three are destroyed.
Destroy the exposed opposing Nexus to win. Kills, damage, gold and a long match are not substitutes for winning.
Attacks and spells obey their actual range, mana, cooldown, level, targeting and crowd-control rules. Terrain stays solid. Avatars use soft spacing.
Use information available to your team. Do not read invisible enemy positions, hidden camp health or private opponent economy.

lessons.title: Advance through the correct objectives
directions: Identify the next attackable structure rather than wasting attacks on a protected building. You may move anywhere legal, but protection prevents damage.
Pressure structures when enemies cannot punish you effectively. A nearby enemy, an incoming wave, health and available allies change the value of pushing.
A destroyed barracks empowers its corresponding allied minion class. Once all three fall and the Nexus opens, turn a safe advantage into a finish.

lessons.title: Farm and use minion waves
directions: Secure valuable last hits when the target is within reach and your hit can finish it. Use farming to gain levels and resources for later fights.
Avoid abandoning every wave to chase an enemy. Compare a reliable last hit or structure hit with the time and risk of a chase.
Carry roles usually need more farm; supports can spend more time helping allies. These are starting priorities, not restrictions on who may farm.
A friendly wave can absorb structure fire and help a siege. A wave is an opportunity, not a mandatory permission slip for every attack.

lessons.title: Choose useful fights and targets
directions: Compare health, nearby team numbers, distance and the damage you can actually deliver. An accessible low-health enemy may be worth finishing.
Do not attack a target merely because it exists. Consider whether a minion, structure, objective or regrouping move offers more value.
Coordinate pressure on reachable opponents. Trading a death can be worthwhile if it helps win the game; deaths are measured rather than universally forbidden.

lessons.title: Manage health, mana and cooldowns
directions: Use damage spells when they have a useful target or useful area effect. Avoid spending mana on an empty fight just because a cooldown is ready.
A costly spell is less attractive when mana is scarce. A finishing hit, protection for an ally or a decisive fight can justify the cost.
Compare continued fighting with moving toward a healing relic, the fountain or a recall. Low health is evidence to consider, not an automatic retreat command.

lessons.title: Move with a purpose and avoid incoming damage
directions: Choose destinations that improve your next action: attack range, an objective, an ally, recovery or a safer firing position.
Notice visible incoming projectiles and their projected paths. Moving away from an imminent impact can be more valuable than another attack.
Ranged avatars can use reach; melee avatars need a practical approach. Terrain and crowds affect routes. Walking and attack orders can be changed as the situation develops.

lessons.title: Support allies and protect damage dealers
directions: Move toward allies when joining them creates a useful local advantage. Nearby allies and enemies matter more than assuming the whole team is present.
Use targeted shields and protection on an appropriate ally, including yourself when the spell permits it. A damaged ally under pressure may benefit more than a healthy one.
Tanks and fighters can create space; assassins can seek accessible threats; mages and marksmen can deliver damage; supports can protect and enable. Roles are context for learning, not fixed scripts.

lessons.title: Understand turret and Nexus danger
directions: Enemy defensive structures deal real damage and can punish you while you attack. Consider exposure, health, allies and what the attack could gain.
Tower dives are permitted strategic choices. Experience should determine when the expected gain is worth the risk.
Moving away from danger can be a good choice. There is no compulsory dive abort, forced sprint or strategic tower-risk veto in this controller.

lessons.title: Use camps and contest major objectives
directions: Ordinary camps provide resources but cost time and health. Compare them with a nearby wave, a structure opportunity or helping the team.
Embermaw and Gravemarch are major objectives. Consider the boss's visible health, your resources and nearby allies and opponents before committing.
During a contest, decide between fighting opponents, protecting allies, disengaging and finishing the boss. There is no fixed boss-health threshold forcing that decision.

lessons.title: Use available information and wards
directions: Known map locations can guide movement without revealing whether a hidden camp is alive or how much health it has.
Place a ward when information could help a fight, approach or objective contest. The current interface places it at your location, so movement helps determine placement.
Reconsider a target that disappears. Moving to its last known location is different from tracking its hidden current position.

lessons.title: Recover and complete useful recalls
directions: Recall channels for 2.5 seconds and can return you to the healing fountain. Compare this with walking, taking a relic or staying for a valuable action.
Once a useful recall has started, allow it to finish when circumstances remain favorable. Movement can cancel it when the situation changes.
Damage and control effects still interrupt according to game mechanics. Recovery is valuable because it enables later play, not because staying in base is a goal.

lessons.title: Use individual abilities and Kaelen's spell system
directions: Choose among legal skill, ultimate and target commands. Healing, shielding, control, damage and movement effects are defined by each avatar's actual kit.
For Kaelen, choose ice, wind or fire orbs, invoke a three-orb recipe, and choose an available invoked spell. Orb sequence and invoked spell identity are distinct model inputs.
Explore different sequences and timing. The former authored combo planner does not choose the sequence for this learned controller.

lessons.title: Turn advantages into a win and learn from results
directions: After a favorable exchange, compare pushing, taking a major objective, farming and recovering. Avoid treating kills as the end of the task.
Protect your own progress while creating pressure on the enemy base. Which trade is best depends on the state and what the team can accomplish next.
Learning updates may become weaker or stronger. Use independent complete matches, both sides and uncertainty to judge improvement; training loss and changed choices alone do not establish it.
Create useful space, interrupt threats and make allied damage possible. Compare engaging with protecting an ally.
Durability is a resource. Taking damage, standing in front or dying first is not success by itself.
A catcher, an area initiator, a mobile disruptor and a sustained brawler require different spacing and timing.
Compare short trades, sustained contact and protecting a nearby ally using your actual shield, movement and control tools.
Enter with a practical follow-up or exit plan; after a useful exchange consider the wave and next structure.
Your kit may favor ranged poke, summons, displacement or territory rather than permanent melee pursuit.
Look for an accessible valuable threat and account for protection, control, travel time and the position after a combo.
Compare spending burst now with waiting for a better opening; abandoning a failed chase can be correct.
A takedown helps when it improves the team's chance to finish the game. Kill stealing is not a separate objective.
Use actual cast ranges, areas, costs and control to deliver pressure while keeping a useful firing position.
Compare wave clear, poke, interruption, allied protection and burst; mana and cooldown availability change the trade.
Channel mages, close burst mages, mobile mages and spellbook mages need different preparation.
Maintain useful attack uptime, use reach and movement between attacks, and choose a reachable target.
Trade farm and sustained pressure against helping a fight. After an advantage, use your attacks on the next legal structure.
An immobile barrage carry needs different protection and timing from a mobile poke carry or sanctuary carry.
Protect and enable living allies, interrupt meaningful threats and help turn a won fight into progress.
Compare shields, healing, control and information with spending resources on damage; missing health and incoming pressure matter.
A catch support, mobile engager, lifeguard and ranged enchanter are different jobs. Supports may still farm or finish enemies when useful.

player_identity: The player card is the competitor; the avatar is the kit they control. Learn the combination rather than confusing their identities.

Observe the card's stable ID, fictional display alias, six attributes, preferred-role fit, signatures, morale, fatigue and both personalities. These inform decisions; they do not grant extra damage, range or immunity.
IQ describes game sense, LAN mechanics, TF teamfight execution, CLU pressure play, STA resilience and FLX adaptability. High attributes do not guarantee a correct decision.
A bodyguard personality can learn protective opportunities and an aggressive personality can learn timing. Neither is a mandatory script or permission to ignore a losing outcome.
The shared policy learns across card/avatar combinations. Do not claim a particular card mastered an avatar unless that pairing has enough independent evaluated evidence.

directions: The actual Nexus win/loss remains the terminal objective. Internal learning rewards update model weights; they do not mint club coins, prizes or card XP.

A small bounded avatar-specific potential uses effective enemy champion health damage, allied damage following confirmed control, actual objective damage and living teammate health. Each specialization weights these differently.

Training credits confirmed stun/root/knockup follow-up only while the recorded effect remains active and only for allied health damage, excluding the controller's own hit. This is a limited attribution measure, not proof the control caused victory.

A cast, missed hook, unused shield, raw damage taken, walking distance or repeated animation has no separate success bonus. Healing/shielding is represented by team survival; exact per-spell rescue attribution is not yet measured.

Reward shaping is a discounted potential difference, with zero potential at real termination. Loops cannot create undiscounted progress bonuses. Censored matches bootstrap; they never receive a fabricated win.
Learning rewards and instruction imitation loss are training signals. Independent matched complete games determine whether a checkpoint improved competitive results.

avatars.tradeoff: Dashing first is not success if the team cannot follow or an ally dies behind you.

Rocks and hard control can interrupt travel. No unit target is required; he can use it to engage or escape. The lightning form does not grant immunity or bypass terrain and tower rules.

abilities.description: Lay a damaging field under clustered foes (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Singularity Well
abilities.description: Channel a compact black hole for 3.2 seconds, pulling enemies within 105 range. Crowd control interrupts the channel (+5% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Plugsy
directions: Use Arc Grapple with an unobstructed opportunity, Charged Fist against a caught threat, and Thunder Dome when close disruption helps allies.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Threatening a hook can preserve space; repeatedly missing hooks is not mastery.

abilities.name: Arc Grapple
abilities.description: A narrow dodgeable grapple pulls an enemy (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Charged Fist
abilities.description: Knock up the caught target (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Thunder Dome
abilities.description: A close electrical burst stuns nearby foes (+5% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Relic Rick
directions: Use Relic Bolt through a useful firing line, compare Phase Skip repositioning with keeping an escape, and align Horizon Lance with reachable pressure.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A blink into danger is not automatically justified by a small amount of poke damage.

abilities.name: Relic Bolt
abilities.description: A fast dodgeable shot through the lane (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Phase Skip
abilities.description: Blink to the side and mark an enemy (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Horizon Lance
abilities.description: A wide piercing beam crosses the fight (+10% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Bounty Belle
directions: Use Ricochet Round and Saltstorm for pressure, then find a Broadside Waltz direction that covers opponents while allies or terrain limit interruption.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: The cone is fixed during its channel; enemies can move out or interrupt it.

abilities.name: Ricochet Round
abilities.description: A dodgeable round bursts into nearby foes (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Saltstorm
abilities.description: Rain shot over an area and slow foes (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Broadside Waltz
abilities.description: Channel a fixed cone of cannon fire in six waves over three seconds. Crowd control interrupts the channel (+10% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Kegory
directions: Use Bursting Cask for clustered pressure, Barrel Rush when its impact control and healing matter, and Grand Vintage to break a threatening formation.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Scattering enemies can spoil allied area damage; disruption is not always a helpful engage.

abilities.name: Bursting Cask
abilities.description: A dodgeable cask explodes among clustered foes (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Barrel Rush
abilities.description: Dashes into a target, knocks them up for 0.8s, and restores 90 health on impact (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Grand Vintage
abilities.description: A huge cask scatters the enemy formation (+5% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Hooklyn
directions: Compare Spectral Harpoon picks with Guiding Lantern protection and displacement. Lantern Prison can slow threats near your damage dealers.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Playing beside a threatened ally can be more useful than behaving like a pure engage tank.

abilities.name: Spectral Harpoon
abilities.description: A dodgeable spectral hook pulls a foe (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Guiding Lantern
abilities.description: Shield nearby allies and push a foe away (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Lantern Prison
abilities.description: Enclose nearby enemies in a slowing spirit cage (+5% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Arsenaldo
directions: Choose Ice, Wind and Fire orbs, invoke a real three-orb recipe, and use either retained spell for the current job: control, protection, damage or pressure.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Orb selection and invocation cost time and mana; repeated preparation without useful casts is not success.

abilities.name: Orb of Ice
abilities.description: Gather an Ice orb into the three-orb FIFO. Each held Ice orb grants 0.2 health regeneration per second at rank 1, scaling by 25% each rank; its bonus ends when it leaves the FIFO.

abilities.name: Orb of Wind
abilities.description: Gather a Wind orb into the three-orb FIFO. Each held Wind orb grants 1 movement speed at rank 1, scaling by 25% each rank; its bonus ends when it leaves the FIFO.

abilities.name: Orb of Fire
abilities.description: Gather a Fire orb into the three-orb FIFO. Each held Fire orb grants 1% spell amp and damage amp at rank 1, scaling by 25% each rank; its bonus ends when it leaves the FIFO.

avatars.name: Inkognito
directions: Use Molten Splatter for pressure, Gleaming Wash when allies can use its protection, and Vortex of Torment where spreading area control can connect.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A visual paint combo does not establish actual protection or damage.

abilities.name: Molten Splatter
abilities.description: Flings an arc of fiery paint that erupts on impact (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Gleaming Wash
abilities.description: Paints an energizing river giving movement speed and shields to allies (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Vortex of Torment
abilities.description: Expands a tragic bloom of spreading paint that grips and detonates (+5% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Hexley
directions: Compare Shock Blast Plasma pressure with a Thundering Leap commitment; use Mercury Overdrive when the resulting attack window can be maintained.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Do not assume an unexposed stance-switch key or that ranged and melee positions are interchangeable.

abilities.name: Shock Blast Plasma
abilities.description: Fires an accelerated plasma orb through an acceleration field (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Thundering Leap
abilities.description: Leaps into the fray, dealing impact damage and rooting the struck target for 0.7s (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Mercury Overdrive
abilities.description: Swaps into cannon mode unleashing rapid fire bursts and shredding defenses (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Knuckleberry
directions: Use Vault Breaker Punch to reach a useful threat, Denting Impact during sustained contact, and Cease and Desist Slam when allies can exploit the lockdown.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Reaching the backline alone may lose more than the selected target is worth.

abilities.name: Vault Breaker Punch
abilities.description: Charges forward delivering an armor-shattering heavy punch (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Denting Impact
abilities.description: Successive blows crack enemy armor and grant bonus attack speed (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Cease and Desist Slam
abilities.description: Locks onto a priority enemy target and slams them downward (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Boomie
directions: Use Fishbones Rockets for reachable clustered pressure, Shock Pistols Zap to slow an approach, and Super Mega Rocket when missing health and the firing line make a finish plausible.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A speculative long-range execute should be compared with reliable damage and objective attacks.

abilities.name: Fishbones Rockets
abilities.description: Swaps to rocket launcher firing explosive long-range area damage (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Shock Pistols Zap
abilities.description: Fires an electric zapper beam that damages and heavily slows the first enemy (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Super Mega Rocket
abilities.description: Fires a colossal global missile that executes enemies based on missing health (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Fizzlewing
directions: Use the actual Illusory Orb and jaunt state, Waning Rift to interrupt nearby threats, and Dream Coil where constrained movement creates follow-up.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A jaunt can land in danger; do not assume the original hero's immunity or extra commands.

abilities.name: Illusory Orb Jaunt
abilities.description: Launches an orb toward the selected position or facing direction; Paxi can jaunt to its current position (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Waning Rift Silence
abilities.description: Blasts a wave of fairy dust silencing nearby enemies in a circle (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Dream Coil Tether
abilities.description: Tethers enemy champions to an astral spring, stunning and tearing them if broken (+5% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Wickety
directions: Use Firefly for useful pressure, Flamebreak to disrupt a formation, and Flaming Lasso to bring a valuable enemy toward allied follow-up.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: The destination of a displacement matters as much as landing it.

abilities.name: Firefly Scorched Path
abilities.description: Takes flight over terrain leaving a deadly burning fire path (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Flamebreak Grenade
abilities.description: Hurls an explosive cocktail knocking back enemies in the area (+10% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Flaming Lasso Drag
abilities.description: Snag an enemy champion with a blazing lasso and drags them into the team (+10% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Hedgehoggin
directions: Use Viscous Nasal Slime to keep a reachable threat in range, Quill Spray for close sustained pressure, and Warpath when repeated contact can help a siege or fight.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: This tank is a sustained brawler, not a substitute for Quakewell's area stun. Taking damage alone earns no reward.

abilities.name: Viscous Nasal Slime
abilities.description: Covers enemy in sticky goo, slowing and reducing their armor (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Quill Spray Nova
abilities.description: Shoots a circle of poisonous quills dealing stacking damage (+5% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Warpath Stampede
abilities.description: Each spell cast increases movement speed and attack damage dramatically (+5% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Orbiton
directions: Launch Spirits through useful attacks, use Overcharge on an ally who can exploit the shield and damage, and gather living allies within Resonant Convergence reach.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A tether to a safe full-health ally may be less useful than moving to a threatened teammate.

abilities.name: Spirits Orbit Array
abilities.description: Summons five bright spirits that orbit Aetheris. Each shot launches a spirit; it bursts on an enemy avatar hit and splashes nearby foes (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Overcharge Surge
abilities.description: Tethers the nearest nearby ally in a bright aura, granting a shield and increased attack damage for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Resonant Convergence
abilities.description: Tethers every living allied avatar within 260 arena units for 5 seconds at rank 1, increasing by 1 second per rank up to 8 seconds at rank 4. Grants each tethered ally an immediate heal and shield.

avatars.name: Pixabelle
directions: Use Glimmerthorn to slow approaches, Mothspell to neutralize a threatening caster, and Wildheart Bloom around a pressured ally.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: A defensive cast should be judged by the resulting survival and team progress, not the number of shields created.

abilities.name: Glimmerthorn
abilities.description: Fire a dodgeable slowing thorn through a target (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Mothspell
abilities.description: Turn a threatening enemy into a harmless moth briefly and shield a nearby ally.

abilities.name: Wildheart Bloom
abilities.description: Grow and shield the lowest-health ally, knocking up enemies around them (+5% AD, +10% AP).

avatars.name: Muffleton
directions: Use Inkblight for pressure, Last Edict against a threatening spell user, and Stillness Decree when enemy casting or a channel makes silence valuable.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Silencing an enemy who is not attempting useful spells can waste the stronger interruption window.

abilities.name: Inkblight
abilities.description: A dodgeable ink bolt damages a target and nearby enemies (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Last Edict
abilities.description: Silence one nearby enemy, preventing ability casts and channels (+5% AD, +10% AP).

abilities.name: Stillness Decree
abilities.description: Briefly silence all living enemies; it can interrupt channeled abilities.

avatars.name: Stafford
directions: Use Longstaff Crack against reachable threats, Mist Double to alter a dangerous position, and Cyclone Dance when repeated close hits and disruption can connect.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Spinning outside enemy reach or chasing beyond allies does not establish useful disruption.

abilities.name: Longstaff Crack
abilities.description: Strike with an extended staff and crack armor (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Mist Double
abilities.description: Leave a visible decoy and slip sideways under a brief veil.

abilities.name: Cyclone Dance
abilities.description: Spin for two seconds, repeatedly hitting and briefly knocking up nearby enemies (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Primate Minister
directions: Use Skyroot Strike to stun a useful line, Canopy Bound to enter a position allies can exploit, and Court of Branches where opponents will contest the stationary area.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: The court does not chase enemies; assess actual occupancy and follow-up.

abilities.name: Skyroot Strike
abilities.description: Slam an extended staff through a short line and stun enemies it crosses (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Canopy Bound
abilities.description: Leap through the trees toward an enemy and land with an area strike (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Court of Branches
abilities.description: Summon a stationary circle of staff-wielding echoes that strike enemies entering it (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Kickswitch
directions: Compare Quarry Rush pressure with Crosswind Guard beside pressured allies. Bellbreak Kick can send a priority enemy toward a team that is ready to punish it.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: Delivering a healthy diver to a wounded teammate can make a technically successful kick harmful.

abilities.name: Quarry Rush
abilities.description: Strike a nearby foe with a driving palm blow (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Crosswind Guard
abilities.description: Brace behind a turning guard and strike enemies crowding nearby allies (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Bellbreak Kick
abilities.description: Deliver a focused turning kick that sends one enemy toward nearby allies, dealing heavy damage and briefly lifting them (+10% AD, +6% AP).

avatars.name: Propella
directions: Use Flakburst against useful clusters, Rotor Overdrive for a real attack window, and Air Superiority when gunship reach and allied protection allow repeated fire.
Reassess after an ally dies, a target becomes protected, a cooldown changes or a structure opens.
avatars.tradeoff: An attack-speed steroid while walking or retreating produces less value than one used during safe firing time.

abilities.name: Flakburst Cannon
abilities.description: Fire a high-velocity flak shell that bursts across a wide enemy cluster (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Rotor Overdrive
abilities.description: Push the flak skiff past redline for 5 seconds of heavy attack speed, then rake the target with crossfire (+10% AD, +6% AP).

abilities.name: Air Superiority
abilities.description: Enter full gunship mode, bombard the target formation, and greatly amplify attack speed and flak splash for up to 11 seconds (+10% AD, +6% AP).
